\n52\t        while (group_cnt > 0) {\n53\t            const double sign = (frand() < 0.5) ? -1.0 : 1.0;\n54\t            const double r = frand() * R;\n55\t            const double dx = (2.0 * \n60\t            if (x < 0 || x > MAX_WIDTH || y < 0 || y > MAX_HEIGHT) {\n61\t                continue;\n62\t            }\n63\t            \n64\t            points[count] = {x, y};\n65\t QT Clustering Benchmark - Simplified Sequential Version\n// \n// QT (Quality Threshold) clustering is an algorithm that builds clusters\n// by starting with a seed point and iteratively adding the closest point\n// that maintains the cluster's diameter below a threshold.\n\n#include <algorithm>\n#include <chrono>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <limits>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\nstatic const double MAX_WIDTH = 20.0;\nstatic const double MAX_HEIGHT = 20.0;\n\n// Structure to represent a point in 2D space\nstruct Point {\n    double x, y;\n};\n\n// Structure to represent a cluster\nstruct Cluster {\n    std::vector<int> members;\n    int seed_point;\n};\n\n// Generate synthetic 2D point data in clusters\nvoid generateSyntheticData(std::vector<Point>& points, const int N, unsigned int seed = 42) {\n    auto frand = [&seed]() mutable { return rand_r(&seed) / static_cast<double>(RAND_MAX); };\n    \n    const double min_dim = std::min(MAX_WIDTH, MAX_HEIGHT);\n    int count = 0;\n    \n    while (count < N) {\n        // Create group_cnt points within a circle of radius R\n        // around center point (cntr_x, cntr_y)\n        const double cntr_x = frand() * MAX_WIDTH;\n        const double cntr_y = frand() * MAX_HEIGHT;\n        const double R = frand() * min_dim / 2.0;\n        int group_cnt = static_cast<int>(frand() * (N / 30.0));\n        \n        // Make sure we don't make more points than we need\n        if (group_cnt > (N - count)) {\n            group_cnt = N - count;\n        }\n        \n        while (group_cnt > 0) {\n            const double sign = (frand() < 0.5) ? -1.0 : 1.0;\n            const double r = frand() * R;\n            const double dx = (2.0 * frand() - 1.0) * r;\n            const double dy = std::sqrt(r * r - dx * dx) * sign;\n            const double x = cntr_x + dx;\n            const double y = cntr_y + dy;\n            \n            if (x < 0 || x > MAX_WIDTH || y < 0 || y > MAX_HEIGHT) {\n                continue;\n            }\n            \n            points[count] = {x, y};\n            count++;\n            group_cnt--;\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Calculate Euclidean distance between two points\ninline double distance(const Point& p1, const Point& p2) {\n    double dx = p1.x - p2.x;\n    double dy = p1.y - p2.y;\n    return std::sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);\n}\n\n// Find the closest unclustered point to the current cluster that maintains diameter < threshold\n// Returns -1 if no such point exists\nint findClosestPoint(const std::vector<int>& cluster_members,\n                     const std::vector<bool>& clustered,\n                     const std::vector<bool>& in_cluster,\n                     const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                     const double threshold,\n                     const int point_count) {\n    int closest_point = -1;\n    double min_diameter = std::numeric_limits<double>::max();\n    \n    // Try each unclustered point as a candidate\n    for (int candidate = 0; candidate < point_count; ++candidate) {\n        // Skip if already clustered or already in this cluster\n        if (clustered[candidate] || in_cluster[candidate]) continue;\n        \n        // Calculate the maximum distance from candidate to all cluster members\n        double max_dist = 0.0;\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < cluster_members.size(); ++i) {\n            const int member = cluster_members[i];\n            const double dist = distance(points[candidate], points[member]);\n            max_dist = std::max(max_dist, dist);\n        }\n        \n        // If adding this point keeps diameter below threshold and is better than current best\n        if (max_dist < threshold && max_dist < min_diameter) {\n            min_diameter = max_dist;\n            closest_point = candidate;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    return closest_point;\n}\n\n// Generate a candidate cluster starting from a seed point\n// Returns the cardinality (size) of the cluster\nint generateCandidateCluster(const int seed_point,\n                              const std::vector<bool>& clustered,\n                              const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                              const double threshold,\n                              const int point_count,\n                              std::vector<int>* cluster_members = nullptr) {\n    std::vector<bool> in_cluster(point_count, false);\n    std::vector<int> members;\n    \n    // Add seed point\n    in_cluster[seed_point] = true;\n    members.push_back(seed_point);\n    \n    // Iteratively add closest points\n    while (static_cast<int>(members.size()) < point_count) {\n        // Find closest point to current cluster that maintains diameter < threshold\n        const int closest = findClosestPoint(members, clustered, in_cluster, points, \n                                             threshold, point_count);\n        \n        if (closest < 0) break; // No more points can be added\n        \n        in_cluster[closest] = true;\n        members.push_back(closest);\n    }\n    \n    // Copy members if requested\n    if (cluster_members) {\n        *cluster_members = members;\n    }\n    \n    return static_cast<int>(members.size());\n}\n\n// Main QT clustering algorithm\nstd::vector<Cluster> qtClustering(const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                                  const double threshold) {\n    const int N = static_cast<int>(points.size());\n    std::vector<bool> clustered(N, false);\n    std::vector<int> unclustered_indices;\n    std::vector<Cluster> clusters;\n    \n    // Initialize unclustered indices\n    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {\n        unclustered_indices.push_back(i);\n    }\n    \n    // Main clustering loop\n    while (!unclustered_indices.empty()) {\n        int max_cardinality = -1;\n        int best_seed = -1;\n        std::vector<int> best_cluster_members;\n        \n        // Try each unclustered point as a seed\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < unclustered_indices.size(); ++i) {\n            const int seed = unclustered_indices[i];\n            if (clustered[seed]) continue;\n            \n            std::vector<int> candidate_members;\n            const int cardinality = generateCandidateCluster(seed, clustered, points, \n                                                       threshold, N, \n                                                       &candidate_members);\n            \n            if (cardinality > max_cardinality) {\n                max_cardinality = cardinality;\n                best_seed = seed;\n                best_cluster_members = candidate_members;\n            }\n        }\n        \n        // If we found a cluster, add it\n        if (best_seed >= 0 && max_cardinality > 0) {\n            Cluster cluster;\n            cluster.seed_point = best_seed;\n            cluster.members = best_cluster_members;\n            clusters.push_back(cluster);\n            \n            // Mark all members as clustered\n            for (size_t i = 0; i < best_cluster_members.size(); ++i) {\n                clustered[best_cluster_members[i]] = true;\n            }\n            \n            // Remove clustered points from unclustered list\n            unclustered_indices.erase(\n                std::remove_if(unclustered_indices.begin(), unclustered_indices.end(),\n                              [&clustered](int idx) { return clustered[idx]; }),\n                unclustered_indices.end()\n            );\n        } else {\n            // No more clusters can be formed\n            break;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    return clusters;\n}\n\n// Validation: check that clusters satisfy the QT clustering properties\nbool validateClusters(const std::vector<Cluster>& clusters,\n                     const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                     const double threshold) {\n    bool valid = true;\n    \n    printf(\"Validating clusters:\\n\");\n    \n    // Check each cluster\n    for (size_t c = 0; c < clusters.size(); ++c) {\n        const auto& cluster = clusters[c];\n        double max_diameter = 0.0;\n        \n        // Check diameter (max distance between any two points)\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < cluster.members.size(); ++i) {\n            for (size_t j = i + 1; j < cluster.members.size(); ++j) {\n                const double dist = distance(points[cluster.members[i]], \n                                           points[cluster.members[j]]);\n                max_diameter = std::max(max_diameter, dist);\n            }\n        }\n        \n        if (c < 10) { // Print first 10 clusters\n            printf(\"  Cluster %zu: size=%zu, seed=%d, diameter=%.4f\\n\", \n                   c, cluster.members.size(), cluster.seed_point, max_diameter);\n        }\n        \n        // Validate diameter is within threshold\n        if (max_diameter > threshold * 1.001) { // Allow small numerical error\n            printf(\"ERROR: Cluster %zu has diameter %.4f > threshold %.4f\\n\", \n                   c, max_diameter, threshold);\n            valid = false;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    // Check for duplicate memberships\n    std::vector<int> membership(points.size(), -1);\n    for (membership[member] >= 0) {\n                printf(\"ERROR: Point %d appears in multiple clusters (%d and %zu)\\n\",\n                       member, membership[member], c);\n                valid = clustered_count, points.size() - clustered_count);\n    \n    return valid;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Number of points (default: 1000)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -t <float>   Distance threshold for clustering (default: 2.0)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    int num_points = 1000;\n    double threshold = 2.0;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n    \n    // Parse command line arguments\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            num_points = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-t\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            threshold = atof(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n            printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    if (num_points <= 0 || threshold <= 0.0) {\n        printf(\"Error: Invalid parameters (num_points=%d, threshold=%.2f)\\n\", \n               num_points, threshold);\n        return 1;\n    }\n    \n    printf(\"QT Clustering Benchmark\\n\");\n    printf(\"Number of points: %d\\n\", num_points);\n    printf(\"Distance threshold: %.2f\\n\", threshold);\n    printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n    \n    // Generate synthetic data\n    std::vector<Point> points(num_points);\n    generateSyntheticData(points, num_points);\n    \n    // Perform QT clustering\n    auto cluster_start = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    \n    const std::vector<Cluster> clusters = qtClustering(points, threshold);\n    \n    auto cluster_end = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    auto cluster_time = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(\n Host code is compiled with -ffp-contract=off and device\n// code with -fmad=false so CPU and GPU distances are bit-identical, making\n// the result independent of the CPU/GPU work split.\n\n#include <algorithm>\n#include <atomic>\n#include <chrono>\n#include <climits>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <limits>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include <cuda_runtime.h>\n#include <mpi.h>\n#include <omp.h>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\nstatic const double MAX_WIDTH = 20.0;\nstatic const double MAX_HEIGHT = 20.0;\n\n#define CUDA_CHECK(call)                                                     \\\n    do {                                                                     \\\n        cudaError_t err__ = (call);          \\\n            MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);                                    \\\n        }                                                                    \\\n    } while (0)\n\n// Structure to represent a point in 2D space\nstruct Point {\n    double x, y;\n};\n\n// Structure to represent a cluster\nstruct Cluster {\n    std::vector<int> members;\n    int seed_point;\n};\n\n// Generate synthetic 2D point data in clusters\nvoid generateSyntheticData(std::vector<Point>& points, const int N, unsigned int seed = 42) {\n    auto frand = [&seed]() mutable { return rand_r(&seed) / static_cast<double>(RAND_MAX); };\n\n    const double min_dim = std::min(MAX_WIDTH, MAX_HEIGHT);\n    int count = 0;\n\n    while (count < N) {\n        // Create group_cnt points within a circle of radius R\n        // around center point (cntr_x, cntr_y)\n        const double cntr_x = frand() * MAX_WIDTH;\n        const double cntr_y = frand() * MAX_HEIGHT;\n        const double R = frand() * min_dim / 2.0;\n        int group_cnt = static_cast<int>(frand() * (N / 30.0));\n\n        // Make sure we don't make more points than we need\n        if (group_cnt > (N - count)) {\n            group_cnt = N - count;\n        }\n\n        while (group_cnt > 0) {\n            const double sign = (frand() < 0.5) ? -1.0 : 1.0;\n            const double r = frand() * R;\n            const double dx = (2.0 * frand() - 1.0) * r;\n            const double dy = std::sqrt(r * r - dx * dx) * sign;\n            const double x = cntr_x + dx;\n            const double y = cntr_y + dy;\n\n            if (x < 0 || x > MAX_WIDTH || y < 0 || y > MAX_HEIGHT) {\n                continue;\n            }\n\n            points[count] = {x, y};\n            count++;\n            group_cnt--;\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Calculate Euclidean distance between two points\ninline double distance(const Point& p1, const Point& p2) {\n    double dx = p1.x - p2.x;\n    double dy = p1.y - p2.y;\n    return std::sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// CUDA kernel: one block grows one candidate cluster from one seed.\n//\n// Per block workspace (in global memory): md[] holds, for each surviving\n// candidate, the maximum distance to the cluster members so far; cand[]\n// holds the candidate's point index. Candidates are pre-filtered to points\n// within `thr` of the seed (any other point can never join). Each growth\n// step fuses the max-distance update with a lexicographic argmin reduction\n// over (max_dist, point index), which reproduces the sequential selection\n// including its tie-break, independent of candidate ordering.\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\nconstexpr int TPB = 256;\n\n__global__ void growClustersKernel(const double2* __restrict__ pts,\n                                   const unsigned char* __restrict__ clustered,\n                                   const int N, const double thr,\n                                   const int* __restrict__ seeds,\n                                   double* __restrict__ workMd,\n                                   int* __restrict__ workCand,\n                                   int* __restrict__ cards) {\n    const int tid = threadIdx.x;\n    const int seed = seeds[blockIdx.x];\n    double* md = workMd + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * N;\n    int* cand = workCand + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * N;\n\n    __shared__ int sL;      // number of surviving candidates\n    __shared__ int sCard;   // current cluster cardinality\n    __shared__ int sCur;    // most recently added member\n    __shared__ double rd[TPB];\n    __shared__ int ri[TPB];\n    __shared__ int rj[TPB];\n\n    if (tid == 0) {\n        sL = 0;\n        sCard = 1;\n        sCur = seed;\n    }\n    __syncthreads();\n\n    // Pre-filter: only unclustered points within thr of the seed can ever join\n    const double2 sp = pts[seed];\n    for (int c = tid; c < N; c += TPB) {\n        if (clustered[c] || c == seed) continue;\n        const double dx = pts[c].x - sp.x;\n        const double dy = pts[c].y - sp.y;\n        const double d = sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);\n        if (d < thr) {\n            const int j = atomicAdd(&sL, 1);\n            cand[j] = c;\n            md[j] = d;\n        }\n    }\n    __syncthreads();\n\n    while (true) {\n        // Fused pass: fold in distances to the newest member, then select the\n        // candidate with the smallest max-distance (ties -> smallest index).\n        const int L = sL;\n        const double2 mp = pts[sCur];\n        double bd = 0.0;\n        int bi = INT_MAX;\n        int bj = -1;\n        for (int j = tid; j < L; j += TPB) {\n            double m = md[j];\n            if (m >= thr) continue;  // permanently dead candidate\n            const int c = cand[j];\n            const double dx = pts[c].x - mp.x;\n            const double dy = pts[c].y - mp.y;\n            const double d = sqrt(dx * dx + dy * m;\n                bi = c;\n                bj = j;\n            }\n        }\n        rd[tid] = bd;\n        ri[tid] = bi;\n        rj[tid] = bj;\n        __syncthreads();\n        for (int s = TPB / 2; s > 0; s >>= 1) {\n            if (tid < s) {\n                const bool other = (ri[tid + s] != INT_MAX) &&\n                    (ri[tid] == INT_MAX || rd[tid + s] < rd[tid] ||\n                     (rd[tid + s] == rd[tid] && ri[tid + s] < ri[tid]));\n                if (other) {\n                    rd[tid] = rd[tid + s];\n                    ri[tid] = ri[tid + s];\n                    rj[tid] = rj[tid + s];\n                }\n            }\n            __syncthreads();\n        }\n        if (ri[0] == INT_MAX) break;  // no candidate can be added\n\n        if (tid == 0) {\n            sCard++;\n            sCur = ri[0];\n            // swap-remove the selected candidate\n            const int last = sL - 1;\n            const int j = rj[0];\n            md[j] = md[last];\n ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// CPU candidate-cluster growth, bit-identical to the GPU kernel (same\n// pre-filter, incremental max-distance, and growClusterCPU(const int seed,\n                          const unsigned char* clustered,\n                          const Point* pts,\n                          const int N,\n (clustered[c] || c == seed) continue;\n        const double d = distance(pts[c], pts[seed]);\n        if (d < thr) {\n            cand[L] = c;\n            md[L] = d;\n            ++L;\n        }\n    }\n\n    if (members) {\n        members->clear();\n        members->push_back(seed);\n    }\n\n    int card = 1;\n    int cur = seed;\n    while (true) {\n        double bd = 0.0;\n        int bi = INT_MAX;\n        int bj = -1;\n        for (int j = 0; j < L; ++j) {\n            double m = md[j];\n            if (m >= thr) continue;\n            const int c = cand[j];\n            const double d = distance(pts[c], pts[cur]);\n            if (d > m) {\n                m = d;\n                md[j] = m;\n            }\n            if (m < thr && (bi == INT_MAX || m < bd || (m == bd && c < bi))) {\n                bd = m;\n                bi = c;\n                bj = j;\n            }\n        }\n        if (bi == INT_MAX) break;\n\n        ++card;\n        cur = bi;\n        if (members) members->push_back(bi);\n        const int last = L - 1;\n        md[bj] = md[last];\n        cand[bj] = cand[last];\n        L = last;\n    }\n    return card;\n}\n\n// Per-rank GPU context (points uploaded once; workspaces reused each round)\nstruct GpuContext {\n    double2* d_pts = nullptr;\n    unsigned char* d_clustered = nullptr;\n    int* d_seeds = nullptr;\n    int* d_cards = std::vector<Point>& points) {\n    const int N = static_cast<int>(points.size());\n\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&gpu.d_pts, static_cast<size_t>(N) * sizeof(double2)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(gpu.d_pts, points.data(),\n                          static_cast<size_t>(N) * sizeof(double2),\n                          cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n 10) / perSeed;\n    cap = std::min(cap, static_cast<size_t>(4096));\n    cap = std::min(cap, static_cast<size_t>(N));\n    cap = std::max(cap, static_cast<size_t>(1));\n    gpu.chunkCap =    for (int p = mpi_rank; p < U; p += mpi_size) {\n            mySeeds.push_back(unclustered_indices[p]);\n        }\n        const int M = static_cast<int>(mySeeds.size());\n\n        int local_card = -1;\n        int local_seed = INT_MAX;\n\n        std::atomic<int> next(0);\n        const int gpuChunk = std::min(gpu.chunkCap, 1024);\n\n        #pragma omp parallel\n        {\n            int t_card = -1;\n            int t_seed = INT_MAX;\n\n            if (omp_get_thread_num() == 0) {\n                // GPU driver thread: grab chunks of seeds, one CUDA block each\n                int cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n                    for (int k = 0; k < n; ++k) {\n                        const int card = h_cards[k];\n                        const int seed = mySeeds[start + k];\n                        if (card > t_card || (card == t_card && seed < t_seed)) {\n                            t_card = card;\n                            t_seed = seed;\n                        }\n                    }\n                }\n            } else {\n                // CPU worker threads: grow candidate clusters host-side\n                std::vector<double> md(N);\n                std::vector<int> cand(N);\n                int start;\n                while ((start = next.fetch_add(2)) < M) {\n                    const int end = std::min(start + 2, M);\n                    for (int k = start; k < end; ++k) {\n                        const int seed = mySeeds[k];\n                        const int card = growClusterCPU(seed, clustered.data(),\n seed < t_seed)) {\n                            t_card = card;\n                            t_seed = seed;\n                        }\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n\n smaller \"location\" on equal values), which is\n        // exactly the sequential iteration order's tie-break.\n        struct { int card; int seed; } best = { local_card, local_seed };\n        MPI_Allreduce(MPI_IN_PLACE, &best, 1, MPI_2INT, MPI_MAXLOC,\n                      MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n        // Regrow the winning cluster deterministically on every rank to\n        // obtain its member list (avoids broadcasting variable-length data).\n        best_members.clear();\n        const int regrown = growClusterCPU(best.seed, clustered.data(),\n                                           points.data(), N, threshold,\n                                           regrowMd.data(), regrowCand.data(),\n                                           &best_members);\n        if (regrown != best.card && mpi_rank == 0) {\n            fprintf(stderr,\n                    \"WARNING: regrown cardinality %d != selected %d (seed %d)\\n\",\n                    regrown, best.card, best.seed);\n clustered\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < best_members.size(); ++i) {\n            clustered[best_members[i]] = 1;\n        }\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(gpu.d_clustered, clustered.data(), N,\n                              cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n\n        // Remove clustered points from unclustered list\n        unclustered_indices.erase(\n            std::remove_if(unclustered_indices.begin(), unclustered_indices.end(),\n                          [&clustered](int idx) { return clustered[idx] != 0; }),\n            unclustered_indices.end()\n        );\n    }\n\n    return clusters;\n}\n\n// Validation: check that clusters satisfy the QT clustering properties\nbool validateClusters(const std::vector<Cluster>& clusters,\n                     const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                     const double threshold) {\n    bool valid = true;\n\n    printf(\"Validating clusters:\\n\");\n\n    // Check each cluster\n    for (size_t c = %zu\\n\",\n           points.size(), clustered_count, points.size() - clustered_count);\n\n    return valid;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", Host code is compiled with -ffp-contract=off and device\n// code with -fmad=false so CPU and GPU distances are bit-identical, making\n// the result independent of the CPU/GPU work split.\n\n#include <algorithm>\n#include <atomic>\n#include <chrono>\n#include <climits>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <limits>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include <cuda_runtime.h>\n#include <mpi.h>\n#include <omp.h>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\nstatic const double MAX_WIDTH = 20.0;\nstatic const double MAX_HEIGHT = 20.0;\n\n#define CUDA_CHECK(call)                                                     \\\n    do {                                                                     \\\n        cudaError_t err__ = (call); };\n\n    const double min_dim = std::min(MAX_WIDTH, MAX_HEIGHT);\n    int count = 0;\n\n    while (count < N) {\n        // Create group_cnt points within a circle of radius R\n        // around center point (cntr_x, cntr_y)\n        const double cntr_x = frand() * MAX_WIDTH;\n        const double cntr_y = frand() * MAX_HEIGHT;\n        const double R = frand() * min_dim / 2.0;\n        int group_cnt = static_cast<int>(frand() * (N / 30.0));\n\n        // Make sure we don't make more points than we need\n        if (group_cnt > (N - count)) {\n            group_cnt = N - count;\n        }\n\n        while (group_cnt > 0) {\n            const double sign = (frand() < 0.5) ? -1.0 : 1.0;\n            const double r = frand() * R;\n            const double dx = (2.0 * frand() - 1.0) * r;\n            const double dy = std::sqrt(r * r - dx * dx) * sign;\n            const double x = cntr_x + dx;\n            const double y = cntr_y + dy;\n\n            if (x < 0 || x > MAX_WIDTH || y < 0 || y > MAX_HEIGHT) {\n                continue;\n            }\n\n            points[count] = {x, y};\n            count++;\n            group_cnt--;\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Calculate Euclidean distance between two points\ninline double distance(const Point& p1, const Point& p2) {\n    double dx = p1.x - p2.x;\n    double dy = p1.y - p2.y;\n    return std::sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// CUDA kernel: one block grows one candidate cluster from one seed.\n//\n// Per block workspace (in global memory): md[] holds, for each surviving\n// candidate, the maximum distance to the cluster members so far; cand[]\n// holds the candidate's point index. Each growth\n// step fuses the max-distance update with a lexicographic argmin reduction\n// over (max_dist, point index), which reproduces the sequential selection\n// including its tie-break, independent of candidate ordering.\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\nconstexpr int TPB = 256;\n\n__global__ void growClustersKernel(const double2* __restrict__ pts,\n                                   const unsigned char* __restrict__ clustered,\n                                   const int N, const double thr,\n int* __restrict__ cards) {\n    const int tid = threadIdx.x;\n    const int seed = seeds[blockIdx.x];\n    double* md = workMd + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * N;\n    int* cand = workCand + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * N;\n\n    __shared__ int sL;      // number of surviving candidates\n    __shared__ int sCard;   // current cluster cardinality\n    __shared__ int sCur;    // most recently added member\n    __shared__ double rd[TPB];\n    __shared__ int ri[TPB];\n    __shared__ int rj[TPB];\n\n    if (tid == 0) {\n        sL = 0;\n        sCard = 1;\n        sCur = seed;\n    }\n    __syncthreads();\n\n    // Pre-filter: only unclustered points within thr of the seed can ever join\n    const double2 sp = pts[seed];\n    for (int c = tid; c < N; c += TPB) {\n        if distances to the newest member, then select the\n        // candidate with the smallest max-distance (ties -> smallest index).\n        const int L = sL;\n        const double2 mp = pts[sCur];\n rj[tid] = rj[tid + s];\n                }\n            }\n            __syncthreads();\n        }\n        if (ri[0] == INT_MAX) break;  // no candidate can be added\n\n        if (tid == 0) {\n growClusterCPU(const int seed,\n                          const unsigned char* clustered,\n                          const Point* pts,\n                          const int N,\n (clustered[c] || c == seed) continue;\n        const double d = distance(pts[c], pts[seed]);\n        if (d < thr) {\n            cand[L] = c;\n            md[L] = d;\n            ++L;\n        }\n bi))) {\n                bd = m;\n                bi = c;\n                bj = j;\n            }\n        }\n        if (bi == INT_MAX) break;\n\n        ++card;\n        cur = bi;\n        if (members) members->push_back(bi);\n        const int last = L - 1;\n        md[bj] = md[last];\n        cand[bj] = cand[last];\n        L = last;\n    }\n    return card;\n}\n\n// Per-rank GPU context std::vector<Point>& points) {\n    const int N = static_cast<int>(points.size());\n\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&gpu.d_pts, static_cast<size_t>(N) * sizeof(double2)));\n MPI_Allreduce(MPI_IN_PLACE, &best, 1, MPI_2INT, MPI_MAXLOC,\n                      MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n        // Regrow the winning cluster deterministically on every rank to\n        // obtain its member list (avoids broadcasting variable-length data).\n        best_members.clear();\n        const int regrown = growClusterCPU(best.seed, clustered.data(),\n best.card && mpi_rank == 0) {\n            fprintf(stderr,\n                    \"WARNING: regrown cardinality %d != selected %d (seed %d)\\n\",\n                    regrown, best.card, best.seed);\n rc;"," }"]}],"originalFile":"// QT Clustering Benchmark - Simplified Sequential Version\n// \n// QT (Quality Threshold) clustering is an algorithm that builds clusters\n// by starting with a seed point and iteratively adding the closest point\n// that maintains the cluster's diameter below a threshold.\n\n#include <algorithm>\n#include <chrono>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <limits>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\nstatic const double MAX_WIDTH = 20.0;\nstatic const double MAX_HEIGHT = 20.0;\n\n// Structure to represent a point in 2D space\nstruct Point {\n    double x, y;\n};\n\n// Structure to represent a cluster\nstruct Cluster {\n    std::vector<int> members;\n    int seed_point;\n};\n\n// Generate synthetic 2D point data in clusters\nvoid generateSyntheticData(std::vector<Point>& points, const int N, unsigned int seed = 42) {\n    auto frand = [&seed]() mutable { return rand_r(&seed) / static_cast<double>(RAND_MAX); };\n    \n    const double min_dim = std::min(MAX_WIDTH, MAX_HEIGHT);\n    int count = 0;\n    \n    while (count < N) {\n        // Create group_cnt points within a circle of radius R\n        // around center point (cntr_x, cntr_y)\n        const double cntr_x = frand() * MAX_WIDTH;\n        const double cntr_y = frand() * MAX_HEIGHT;\n        const double R = frand() * min_dim / 2.0;\n        int group_cnt = static_cast<int>(frand() * (N / 30.0));\n        \n        // Make sure we don't make more points than we need\n        if (group_cnt > (N - count)) {\n            group_cnt = N - count;\n        }\n        \n        while (group_cnt > 0) {\n            const double sign = (frand() < 0.5) ? -1.0 : 1.0;\n            const double r = frand() * R;\n            const double dx = (2.0 * frand() - 1.0) * r;\n            const double dy = std::sqrt(r * r - dx * dx) * sign;\n            const double x = cntr_x + dx;\n            const double y = cntr_y + dy;\n            \n            if (x < 0 || x > MAX_WIDTH || y < 0 || y > MAX_HEIGHT) {\n                continue;\n            }\n            \n            points[count] = {x, y};\n            count++;\n            group_cnt--;\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Calculate Euclidean distance between two points\ninline double distance(const Point& p1, const Point& p2) {\n    double dx = p1.x - p2.x;\n    double dy = p1.y - p2.y;\n    return std::sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);\n}\n\n// Find the closest unclustered point to the current cluster that maintains diameter < threshold\n// Returns -1 if no such point exists\nint findClosestPoint(const std::vector<int>& cluster_members,\n                     const std::vector<bool>& clustered,\n                     const std::vector<bool>& in_cluster,\n                     const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                     const double threshold,\n                     const int point_count) {\n    int closest_point = -1;\n    double min_diameter = std::numeric_limits<double>::max();\n    \n    // Try each unclustered point as a candidate\n    for (int candidate = 0; candidate < point_count; ++candidate) {\n        // Skip if already clustered or already in this cluster\n        if (clustered[candidate] || in_cluster[candidate]) continue;\n        \n        // Calculate the maximum distance from candidate to all cluster members\n        double max_dist = 0.0;\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < cluster_members.size(); ++i) {\n            const int member = cluster_members[i];\n            const double dist = distance(points[candidate], points[member]);\n            max_dist = std::max(max_dist, dist);\n        }\n        \n        // If adding this point keeps diameter below threshold and is better than current best\n        if (max_dist < threshold && max_dist < min_diameter) {\n            min_diameter = max_dist;\n            closest_point = candidate;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    return closest_point;\n}\n\n// Generate a candidate cluster starting from a seed point\n// Returns the cardinality (size) of the cluster\nint generateCandidateCluster(const int seed_point,\n                              const std::vector<bool>& clustered,\n                              const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                              const double threshold,\n                              const int point_count,\n                              std::vector<int>* cluster_members = nullptr) {\n    std::vector<bool> in_cluster(point_count, false);\n    std::vector<int> members;\n    \n    // Add seed point\n    in_cluster[seed_point] = true;\n    members.push_back(seed_point);\n    \n    // Iteratively add closest points\n    while (static_cast<int>(members.size()) < point_count) {\n        // Find closest point to current cluster that maintains diameter < threshold\n        const int closest = findClosestPoint(members, clustered, in_cluster, points, \n                                             threshold, point_count);\n        \n        if (closest < 0) break; // No more points can be added\n        \n        in_cluster[closest] = true;\n        members.push_back(closest);\n    }\n    \n    // Copy members if requested\n    if (cluster_members) {\n        *cluster_members = members;\n    }\n    \n    return static_cast<int>(members.size());\n}\n\n// Main QT clustering algorithm\nstd::vector<Cluster> qtClustering(const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                                  const double threshold) {\n    const int N = static_cast<int>(points.size());\n    std::vector<bool> clustered(N, false);\n    std::vector<int> unclustered_indices;\n    std::vector<Cluster> clusters;\n    \n    // Initialize unclustered indices\n    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {\n        unclustered_indices.push_back(i);\n    }\n    \n    // Main clustering loop\n    while (!unclustered_indices.empty()) {\n        int max_cardinality = -1;\n        int best_seed = -1;\n        std::vector<int> best_cluster_members;\n        \n        // Try each unclustered point as a seed\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < unclustered_indices.size(); ++i) {\n            const int seed = unclustered_indices[i];\n            if (clustered[seed]) continue;\n            \n            std::vector<int> candidate_members;\n            const int cardinality = generateCandidateCluster(seed, clustered, points, \n                                                       threshold, N, \n                                                       &candidate_members);\n            \n            if (cardinality > max_cardinality) {\n                max_cardinality = cardinality;\n                best_seed = seed;\n                best_cluster_members = candidate_members;\n            }\n        }\n        \n        // If we found a cluster, add it\n        if (best_seed >= 0 && max_cardinality > 0) {\n            Cluster cluster;\n            cluster.seed_point = best_seed;\n            cluster.members = best_cluster_members;\n            clusters.push_back(cluster);\n            \n            // Mark all members as clustered\n            for (size_t i = 0; i < best_cluster_members.size(); ++i) {\n                clustered[best_cluster_members[i]] = true;\n            }\n            \n            // Remove clustered points from unclustered list\n            unclustered_indices.erase(\n                std::remove_if(unclustered_indices.begin(), unclustered_indices.end(),\n                              [&clustered](int idx) { return clustered[idx]; }),\n                unclustered_indices.end()\n            );\n        } else {\n            // No more clusters can be formed\n            break;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    return clusters;\n}\n\n// Validation: check that clusters satisfy the QT clustering properties\nbool validateClusters(const std::vector<Cluster>& clusters,\n                     const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                     const double threshold) {\n    bool valid = true;\n    \n    printf(\"Validating clusters:\\n\");\n    \n    // Check each cluster\n    for (size_t c = 0; c < clusters.size(); ++c) {\n        const auto& cluster = clusters[c];\n        double max_diameter = 0.0;\n        \n        // Check diameter (max distance between any two points)\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < cluster.members.size(); ++i) {\n            for (size_t j = i + 1; j < cluster.members.size(); ++j) {\n                const double dist = distance(points[cluster.members[i]], \n                                           points[cluster.members[j]]);\n                max_diameter = std::max(max_diameter, dist);\n            }\n        }\n        \n        if (c < 10) { // Print first 10 clusters\n            printf(\"  Cluster %zu: size=%zu, seed=%d, diameter=%.4f\\n\", \n                   c, cluster.members.size(), cluster.seed_point, max_diameter);\n        }\n        \n        // Validate diameter is within threshold\n        if (max_diameter > threshold * 1.001) { // Allow small numerical error\n            printf(\"ERROR: Cluster %zu has diameter %.4f > threshold %.4f\\n\", \n                   c, max_diameter, threshold);\n            valid = false;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    // Check for duplicate memberships\n    std::vector<int> membership(points.size(), -1);\n    for (size_t c = 0; c < clusters.size(); ++c) {\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < clusters[c].members.size(); ++i) {\n            const int member = clusters[c].members[i];\n            if (membership[member] >= 0) {\n                printf(\"ERROR: Point %d appears in multiple clusters (%d and %zu)\\n\",\n                       member, membership[member], c);\n                valid = false;\n            }\n            membership[member] = static_cast<int>(c);\n        }\n    }\n    \n    // Count clustered points\n    int clustered_count = 0;\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < membership.size(); ++i) {\n        if (membership[i] >= 0) clustered_count++;\n    }\n    \n    printf(\"Total points: %zu, Clustered: %d, Unclustered: %zu\\n\",\n           points.size(), clustered_count, points.size() - clustered_count);\n    \n    return valid;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Number of points (default: 1000)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -t <float>   Distance threshold for clustering (default: 2.0)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    int num_points = 1000;\n    double threshold = 2.0;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n    \n    // Parse command line arguments\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            num_points = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-t\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            threshold = atof(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n compile it with nvcc.\nset_source_files_properties(qtclustering.cpp PROPERTIES LANGUAGE CUDA)\n\n# -fmad=false (device) and -ffp-contract=off (host) keep CPU and GPU distance\n# computations bit-identical, so results are independent of the work split.\ntarget_compile_options(qtclustering PRIVATE\n    -O3 -fmad=false\n    -Xcompiler=-O3,-march=native,-fopenmp,-ffp-contract=off,-Wall,-Wextra)\n\n# Link math library, MPI, and OpenMP runtime\ntarget_link_libraries(qtclustering PRIVATE MPI::MPI_CXX ${OpenMP_CXX_LIBRARIES} m)\ntarget_link_options(qtclustering PRIVATE -Xcompiler=-fopenmp)\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":27,"oldLines":4,"newStart":27,"newLines":4,"lines":[" "," # Link math library, MPI, and OpenMP runtime"," target_link_libraries(qtclustering PRIVATE MPI::MPI_CXX ${OpenMP_CXX_LIBRARIES} m)","-target_link_options(qtclustering PRIVATE -Xcompiler=-fopenmp)","+target_link_options(qtclustering PRIVATE -fopenmp)"]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false}}

Seeds are\n//    distributed cyclically across MPI ranks (points are replicated).\n//  - Within a rank, seeds are processed by a work-stealing pool: OpenMP\n//    thread 0 drives the local GPU (one CUDA block grows one candidate\n//    cluster), while the remaining OpenMP threads grow candidate clusters\n//    on the CPU.\n//  - The globally best (cardinality, seed) pair is selected with an\n//    MPI_MAXLOC reduction, which matches the sequential tie-break exactly\n//    (largest cluster, smallest seed index on ties).\n//\n// Candidate growth uses incremental max-distance tracking and pre-filters\n// candidates to points within `threshold` of the seed; both are exact\n// transformations of the original greedy algorithm (identical selections\n// and tie-breaks). Host code is compiled with -ffp-contract=off and device\n// code with -fmad=false so CPU and GPU distances are bit-identical, making\n// the result independent of the CPU/GPU work split.\n\n#include <algorithm>\n#include <atomic>\n#include <chrono>\n#include <climits>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <limits>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include <cuda_runtime.h>\n#include <mpi.h>\n#include <omp.h>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\nstatic const double MAX_WIDTH = 20.0;\nstatic const double MAX_HEIGHT = 20.0;\n\n#define CUDA_CHECK(call)                                                     \\\n    do {                                                                     \\\n        cudaError_t err__ = (call);                                          \\\n        if (err__ != cudaSuccess) {                                          \\\n            fprintf(stderr, \"CUDA error %s at %s:%d\\n\",                      \\\n                    cudaGetErrorString(err__), __FILE__, __LINE__);          \\\n            MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);                                    \\\n        }                                                                    \\\n    } while (0)\n\n// Structure to represent a point in 2D space\nstruct Point {\n    double x, y;\n};\n\n// Structure to represent a cluster\nstruct Cluster {\n    std::vector<int> members;\n    int seed_point;\n};\n\n// Generate synthetic 2D point data in clusters\nvoid generateSyntheticData(std::vector<Point>& points, const int N, unsigned int seed = 42) {\n    auto frand = [&seed]() mutable { return rand_r(&seed) / static_cast<double>(RAND_MAX); };\n\n    const double min_dim = std::min(MAX_WIDTH, MAX_HEIGHT);\n    int count = 0;\n\n    while (count < N) {\n        // Create group_cnt points within a circle of radius R\n        // around center point (cntr_x, cntr_y)\n        const double cntr_x = frand() * MAX_WIDTH;\n        const double cntr_y = frand() * MAX_HEIGHT;\n        const double R = frand() * min_dim / 2.0;\n        int group_cnt = static_cast<int>(frand() * (N / 30.0));\n\n        // Make sure we don't make more points than we need\n        if (group_cnt > (N - count)) {\n            group_cnt = N - count;\n        }\n\n        while (group_cnt > 0) {\n            const double sign = (frand() < 0.5) ? -1.0 : 1.0;\n            const double r = frand() * R;\n            const double dx = (2.0 * frand() - 1.0) * r;\n            const double dy = std::sqrt(r * r - dx * dx) * sign;\n            const double x = cntr_x + dx;\n            const double y = cntr_y + dy;\n\n            if (x < 0 || x > MAX_WIDTH || y < 0 || y > MAX_HEIGHT) {\n                continue;\n            }\n\n            points[count] = {x, y};\n            count++;\n            group_cnt--;\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Calculate Euclidean distance between two points\ninline double distance(const Point& p1, const Point& p2) {\n    double dx = p1.x - p2.x;\n    double dy = p1.y - p2.y;\n    return std::sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// CUDA kernel: one block grows one candidate cluster from one seed.\n//\n// Per block workspace (in global memory): md[] holds, for each surviving\n// candidate, the maximum distance to the cluster members so far; cand[]\n// holds the candidate's point index. Candidates are pre-filtered to points\n// within `thr` of the seed (any other point can never join). Each growth\n// step fuses the max-distance update with a lexicographic argmin reduction\n// over (max_dist, point index), which reproduces the sequential selection\n// including its tie-break, independent of candidate ordering.\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\nconstexpr int TPB = 256;\n\n__global__ void growClustersKernel(const double2* __restrict__ pts,\n                                   const unsigned char* __restrict__ clustered,\n                                   const int N, const double thr,\n                                   const int* __restrict__ seeds,\n                                   double* __restrict__ workMd,\n                                   int* __restrict__ workCand,\n                                   int* __restrict__ cards) {\n    const int tid = threadIdx.x;\n    const int seed = seeds[blockIdx.x];\n    double* md = workMd + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * N;\n    int* cand = workCand + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * N;\n\n    __shared__ int sL;      // number of surviving candidates\n    __shared__ int sCard;   // current cluster cardinality\n    __shared__ int sCur;    // most recently added member\n    __shared__ double rd[TPB];\n    __shared__ int ri[TPB];\n    __shared__ int rj[TPB];\n\n    if (tid == 0) {\n        sL = 0;\n        sCard = 1;\n        sCur = seed;\n    }\n    __syncthreads();\n\n    // Pre-filter: only unclustered points within thr of the seed can ever join\n    const double2 sp = pts[seed];\n    for (int c = tid; c < N; c += TPB) {\n        if (clustered[c] || c == seed) continue;\n        const double dx = pts[c].x - sp.x;\n        const double dy = pts[c].y - sp.y;\n        const double d = sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);\n        if (d < thr) {\n            const int j = atomicAdd(&sL, 1);\n            cand[j] = c;\n            md[j] = d;\n        }\n    }\n    __syncthreads();\n\n    while (true) {\n        // Fused pass: fold in distances to the newest member, then select the\n        // candidate with the smallest max-distance (ties -> smallest index).\n        const int L = sL;\n        const double2 mp = pts[sCur];\n        double bd = 0.0;\n        int bi = INT_MAX;\n        int bj = -1;\n        for (int j = tid; j < L; j += TPB) {\n            double m = md[j];\n            if (m >= thr) continue;  // permanently dead candidate\n            const int c = cand[j];\n            const double dx = pts[c].x - mp.x;\n            const double dy = pts[c].y - mp.y;\n            const double d = sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);\n            if (d > m) {\n                m = d;\n                md[j] = m;\n            }\n            if (m < thr && (bi == INT_MAX || m < bd || (m == bd && c < bi))) {\n                bd = m;\n                bi = c;\n                bj = j;\n            }\n        }\n        rd[tid] = bd;\n        ri[tid] = bi;\n        rj[tid] = bj;\n        __syncthreads();\n        for (int s = TPB / 2; s > 0; s >>= 1) {\n            if (tid < s) {\n                const bool other = (ri[tid + s] != INT_MAX) &&\n                    (ri[tid] == INT_MAX || rd[tid + s] < rd[tid] ||\n                     (rd[tid + s] == rd[tid] && ri[tid + s] < ri[tid]));\n                if (other) {\n                    rd[tid] = rd[tid + s];\n                    ri[tid] = ri[tid + s];\n {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-fable-5","id":"msg_011CeiwJKwbjg9JAAMxzUU8u","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"Done. The QT clustering benchmark is now a hybrid MPI + OpenMP + CUDA program, modified in place in `qtclustering/qtclustering.cpp` and `qtclustering/CMakeLists.txt` only, same executable name, no new dependencies. It produces **bit-identical results to the sequential original** (verified by matching the `-r` output hash at n=40, 1000 (thresholds 2.0 and 0.5), 2000, and 3000 against runs of the untouched original, across 1–8 MPI ranks and various thread counts) and passes `-v` validation up to n=100,000.\n\n**Performance** (4 ranks on this 4× RTX 3090 / 256-core node):\n- n=1000: 7,014 ms → ~15 ms (~470×)\n- n=2000: 88,617 ms → 25 ms (~3,500×)\n- n=3000: 479,097 ms → 43 ms (~11,000×)\n- n=50,000: ~12 s; n=100,000: ~81 s (both intractable for the original)\n\n**How it's parallelized:**\n- **MPI:** points are replicated; each round, the candidate seeds (all unclustered points) are distributed cyclically across ranks. The global winner is picked with an `MPI_MAXLOC` reduction on `(cardinality, seed)`, which reproduces the sequential tie-break exactly (largest cluster, smallest seed on ties). The winning cluster is regrown deterministically on every rank, avoiding variable-length broadcasts. One GPU per rank via shared-memory local rank.\n- **CUDA:** one thread block grows one complete candidate cluster (each growth step is a fused max-distance update + block-wide lexicographic argmin over `(max_dist, point index)`, matching the sequential selection order-independently). A chunk of seeds runs as one grid; workspace is sized to free GPU memory.\n- **OpenMP:** within each rank, a work-stealing pool over the rank's seeds — thread 0 drives the GPU in adaptively-shrinking chunks while the remaining threads grow candidate clusters on the CPU. Host is compiled with `-ffp-contract=off` and device with `-fmad=false`, so CPU and GPU arithmetic is bit-identical and the result is independent of the CPU/GPU split. OpenMP also parallelizes the diameter validation.\n- The growth itself was restructured (exactly, not approximately): incremental per-candidate max-distance tracking plus pre-filtering to points within `threshold` of the seed turns O(N·S²) per seed into O(N·S) with identical selections.\n\nTwo things worth knowing when you run it: Open MPI's default binding pins `-np 1`/`-np 2` runs to a single core, which starves the OpenMP threads — use `mpirun --bind-to none` (or your cluster's proper binding) for hybrid runs. Also, `-n` below ~31 hangs in `generateSyntheticData`; that infinite loop exists in the original code and was left semantically untouched."}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":341,"cache_read_input_tokens":70730,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":341},"output_tokens":800,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"47f83fe6-fd59-4a23-9035-aa3cf088b0c3","uuid":"2dd82835-ab9e-4b33-9f5e-e1942e1d0722","timestamp":"2026-09-04T19:17:37.244Z","request_id":"req_011CeiwJJgh3uW2KDoiFcpFu"}
